question:
Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.

Neeraj said that he would go as soon as it was possible.

options.text: Neeraj say, “I shall went as soon as it is possible”.
Neeraj say, “I should go as soon as it is possible”.
Neeraj said, “I shall go as soon as it is possible”.
Neeraj says, “I may went as soon as it was possible”.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**
